subject: Sunderland beat Chelsea 1-0 for first Premier League win since August, days after Europa League loss
title: Sunderland's first win since August

lines.vo: Sunderland's first Premier League win since August. Against Chelsea. One-nil.
Brian Brobbey was brought down. Enzo Le Fee scored the penalty in the thirty-sixth minute. Job done, doors locked.
Sunderland came off the bottom. Chelsea fell out of the top four, with a fourth league defeat. A perfect swap.
Xabi Alonso denied Chelsea were bullied. He admitted they could have defended better. Politely put.
Days before, Sunderland lost two-nil at home to Dinamo Zagreb. Beaten by Zagreb, then Chelsea beaten by Sunderland. Football does not do logic.
Regis Le Bris was under pressure, with one win from nine. Thank you, Chelsea.
